rows.en: An especially loud metallic clang rang out, and the door bearing the medal crest quietly swung open.

"Arms Memory"
The Gaia Memory of weapons
The letter "A" is marked in the center of the Memory.
There was a faint sound from over by the door.
An especially loud metallic clang rang out, and the door bearing the medal crest quietly swung open.

"Puppeteer Memory"
The Gaia Memory of the puppeteer
The letter "P" is marked in the center of the Memory.
An especially loud metallic clang rang out, and the door bearing the medal crest quietly swung open.
Look! They've got Cell Medals on display!
But there was nothing on display there.
Tch! Why the hell isn't the real thing here!? The bird Cores are mine!
But there was nothing on display there.
But there was nothing on display there.
But there was nothing on display there.
But there was nothing on display there.
The actual medals were on display there.
Kazari's Core Medals, huh. Right, I'll be taking these.
Whoops, I can't let you do that!?
Suddenly, someone cut in and snatched the three Core Medals from Ankh.
These are my Cores, after all. Sorry, but I'll be taking them, okay?
Then Kazari pushed the Core Medals in his hand into his body, one by one.
Kazari...!? Damn you, hogging the spotlight!!
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? Hey, Ankh, what on earth is...?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is going on!?
Kazari...!? What on earth has happened!?
Kazari...!? What on earth has happened!?
Kazari!? So this is what a Greeed is!? What on earth is going on!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Kazari...!? What on earth is happening!?
Whoaaa!! Whoops... I let my guard down.

notes.note: Continues the G-A-I-A Memory door puzzle from story_094; captions, voice calls, door text and Ankh's 'That did it!' reuse story_094's wording for consistency.
Faint 'Click...' only for Arms (A), matching the G-A-I-A puzzle as in story_094; Puppeteer gets none.
Puppeteer Memory: official W name; not in glossary.
Source says Cell Medals although the exhibits that follow are Core Medal cases; kept as written (possibly a source slip for Core Medals).

Core Medal exhibit captions keep the two-line layout. Medal names use the established romanized OOO names (Taka/Kujaku/Condor, Shachi/Unagi/Tako, Kuwagata/Kamakiri/Batta, Sai/Gorilla/Zou, Lion/Tora/Cheetah), in line with the glossary's 'Taka Candroid'. Not in glossary. 'X-type' mirrors the source suffix and the earlier 'bird-type Greeed'. Source has 'electric eel'; given as the usual medal name Unagi.
??? = Kazari (revealed at #0.9). Teasing 'sou wa ikanai yo' kept with the source's !?.

#0.13-27 = 15 leader variants (TextIdOffset+12+k). Order from the second Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0560.bla (ids 5,4,3,2,1,6,15,7,14,12,11,13,8,9,10): OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zero, Zeta, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, id 13 (unidentified, Ultra-like), God, Wing Zero, 00. Confirmed by wording: Momotaros taunt at k2, 'nanoda' (Seven/Ultraman) at k9-10, Ultras' Gah/Gwah cluster at k8-11 in #0.31-45. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Momotaros: 'medachi-yagatte' = showing off / stealing the spotlight, kept rude.
Rider 1 slot by chain order; trailing-off question kept unfinished.
Slot k11 = chara id 13 (unidentified; an Ultra by the #0.42 cry), reacting to a Greeed for the first time.
Momotaros slot: surprised yell then 'let my guard down'; subject 'I' restored.

report: 80/80 rows. Memory-door rows reuse story_094 wording. Leader-variant order for #0.13-27 and #0.31-45 from 0560.bla second Pt_Chara_Check chain; slot k11 (chara id 13) unidentified. 0551 #0.1 source says Cell Medals before Core Medal exhibits (kept). Not in glossary: Arms/Puppeteer/Yesterday Memory, Core Medal names (romanized OOO names).
